`umami-kotlin` is a Kotlin Multiplatform Umami REST API wrapper. Modules: `:umami`, `:sample:simple-compose-app`, `:sample:terminalApp`. Uses Ktor, Kotlinx Coroutines/Serialization, `kotlin.time.Instant`, Kermit, Kotest, Mokkery; tests should use Kotest matchers. All contributions must adhere to the guidelines outlined in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Detekt: `detekt/detekt.yml`; Qlty: `.qlty/qlty.toml`. Please ensure your changes do not introduce any new static analysis issues. All new features must be accompanied by tests. Bug fixes should also include a test that reproduces the bug. When verifying that your changes compile and work correctly, run the JVM tests for the specific module you modified:
`./gradlew :umami:jvmTest`
`./gradlew :umami-api:jvmTest`
`./gradlew :sample:terminalApp:jvmTest`
Generate docs: `./gradlew dokkaHtml`.
